seed_ledger.name: Monarch Data Center power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: 500 MW gas plant (single-cycle turbines) at the Copia campus about 8 miles north of Yerington; coverage names a gen-tie to Walker River Substation and a temporary-plant request to Nevada regulators, but no gas lateral or supplier. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: local news (KOLO, Fernley Reporter, Nevada Independent, DCD) showed approvals and plant size only; a Great Basin pipeline search showed the CP25-209 expansion and governor support, with no Yerington or Mason Valley tie; EIA, FERC, NDEP air permit and Lyon County records not found naming a lateral; developer pages silent on gas. Great Basin main line is 3.5 km away.

evidence.note: Aug 2026 rezoning approval for Monarch Data Center and gas-fired plant; no gas supply named
